features.objective: Add HarnessRegistry.rank(task, workspace) in agent_lab/harnesses/registry.py. Return deterministic dictionaries with keys id, version, applicability, selected. Respect allowed_harnesses. Sort by descending applicability then manifest.id ascending for ties. Refactor select() to use the same ordering while preserving required_harnesses behavior.
features.public_validator:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from agent_lab.harnesses.registry import HarnessRegistry
from agent_lab.schemas import TaskSpec
with TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 p=Path(td); (p/'x.py').write_text('x=1\n')
 t=TaskSpec(objective='x',task_type='python')
 r=HarnessRegistry(); rows=r.rank(t,p)
 assert rows and all({'id','version','applicability','selected'} <= set(x) for x in rows)
 assert sum(bool(x['selected']) for x in rows)==1
 chosen=next(x['id'] for x in rows if x['selected'])
 assert r.select(t,p).manifest.id==chosen
print('PUBLIC_OK')
features.hidden_validator:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from agent_lab.harnesses.base import Harness,HarnessManifest
from agent_lab.harnesses.registry import HarnessRegistry
from agent_lab.schemas import HarnessResult,TaskSpec
class H(Harness):
 def __init__(self,i): self.manifest=HarnessManifest(i,'1',('python',),i)
 def applicability(self,t,w): return 0.5
 def execute(self,t,w): return HarnessResult(harness_id=self.manifest.id,harness_version='1',status='passed')
with TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 p=Path(td); (p/'x.py').write_text('x=1\n')
 r=HarnessRegistry([H('zeta'),H('alpha')])
 t=TaskSpec(objective='x',task_type='python',allowed_harnesses=['zeta','alpha'])
 rows=r.rank(t,p)
 assert [x['id'] for x in rows]==['alpha','zeta']
 assert rows[0]['selected'] is True and rows[1]['selected'] is False
print('HIDDEN_OK')

features.objective: Add preview_exact_edits(workspace, edits, allow_test_edits=False) in agent_lab/worker/patches.py. It must perform the same validation as apply_exact_edits without writing anything and return exact keys files, operations, total_bytes. Refactor shared planning logic so preview and apply cannot drift.
features.public_validator:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from agent_lab.worker.patches import preview_exact_edits
with TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 p=Path(td); f=p/'a.py'; f.write_text('x = 1\n')
 edits=[{'op':'replace','path':'a.py','old':'x = 1','new':'x = 2'},{'op':'create','path':'b.py','content':'y = 3\n'}]
 m=preview_exact_edits(p,edits)
 assert set(m)=={'files','operations','total_bytes'} and m['files']==['a.py','b.py'] and m['operations']==2
 assert f.read_text()=='x = 1\n' and not (p/'b.py').exists()
print('PUBLIC_OK')
features.hidden_validator:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from agent_lab.worker.patches import PatchError,preview_exact_edits
with TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 p=Path(td); (p/'a.py').write_text('value=1\n')
 try:
  preview_exact_edits(p,[{'op':'replace','path':'a.py','old':'missing','new':'x'}])
  raise AssertionError('ambiguous invalid edit accepted')
 except PatchError: pass
 assert (p/'a.py').read_text()=='value=1\n'
 try:
  preview_exact_edits(p,[{'op':'create','path':'.env','content':'SECRET=1'}])
  raise AssertionError('secret path accepted')
 except PatchError: pass
print('HIDDEN_OK')

features.objective: Add collect_repository_context_with_stats(workspace, max_bytes=60000, objective=None, include=None, exclude=None) in agent_lab/worker/context.py. Return (text, stats) where stats has exact keys files_included, bytes_used, truncated. Refactor collect_repository_context to delegate to it while preserving output and scoping behavior.
features.public_validator:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from agent_lab.worker.context import collect_repository_context,collect_repository_context_with_stats
with TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 p=Path(td); (p/'a.py').write_text('A=1\n'); (p/'b.md').write_text('hello\n')
 text,stats=collect_repository_context_with_stats(p,max_bytes=5000)
 assert text==collect_repository_context(p,max_bytes=5000)
 assert set(stats)=={'files_included','bytes_used','truncated'}
 assert stats['files_included']==2 and stats['bytes_used']==len(text.encode()) and stats['truncated'] is False
print('PUBLIC_OK')
